about: REAL observed examples (headlines seen in the radar's own data, with the date observed), hand-labelled with what an editor expects. Kept apart from synthetic fixtures (eval-synthetic.json). scripts/evaluate.mjs checks each against the current local data; an example older than the 48-hour data window is reported as 'out of window', not as a miss.
